question: 查看订单状态分布
executed_sql:
WITH status_counts AS (SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status) SELECT status, order_count, ROUND(order_count * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM status_counts), 2) AS pct FROM status_counts ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 500
